content: Big day out in Philly. I did it all. L and I bough a shelf at the thrift store for $15 and found out it sells for $400-$1800
L and I went for a walk around the creek. We saw elderly people frozen in place, three baby bunnies, and a snake named Frederick
The band was going to meet up but S got held up at an intense union meeting. D sang an AI song to me.
I impulse bought a guitar today. C and S found a Samick SG at Atomic Music that is perfect
I made a lot of progress on my website. I added a 'vignettes' section that will house what I have here
Full band practice tonight. It was so hot in the warehouse, but I had a great time. It's really cool to all get together.
Getting home wasn't the easiest. We were both tired. Being home has been the best. We finished Love Island and beat our first 7th day.
Brooklyn, NY, Shoppy-shops. Team Rocket at the front desk. Running late. Running through rain. Subway Kamina. Ariana Grande.
